subject: Coord: Night/Near-midnight Fleet & Parking Flow for SF Executive Workshop
messages:
From: Olson Logistics <ops@olsonlogistics.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com, events@cahill.co
Date: 2026-12-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Night operations — arrival window and overnight staging

Hi Marissa / Logan,

Quick question as we finalize driver assignments for the Dec 20 exec arrivals: the venue noted a strict noise curfew and limited overnight vendor parking. Can you confirm: 1) loading dock access window for rideshare/rental drop-offs (we're planning some late arrivals around 23:30–00:30), 2) whether we can stage 6 cars overnight in Lot B (vendor passes?), and 3) a secure on-site location for drivers to rest/leave keys?

We can provide the driver roster and manifest once you confirm the policy — attaching our fleet_manifest_template.csv for your reference. Also let us know if any permits are required so we can submit on our side.

Thanks,
Ben Olson
Ops Manager, Olson Logistics
attachments: fleet_manifest_template.csv (CSV)

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Olson Logistics <ops@olsonlogistics.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com, logan_wright@redwoodinference.com, events@cahill.co
Date: 2026-12-18T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Night operations — arrival window and overnight staging

Ben — thanks for the template, and good call flagging timelines. Short answers up front: loading dock access ok for 22:00–02:00 with prior notice; Lot B can accommodate up to 6 vendor vehicles overnight but requires a permit request; quiet hours start at 23:00 (no amplified announcements after then).

Logistics details: 
- Staging: Use the service lane on 2nd Street (map attached) for drop-offs. Drivers should radio "Event Ops" on channel 3 when 10 minutes out.
- Overnight vendor parking: We can provide 6 passes for Lot B; Naomi is handling the permit submission (cc'd). Please send your final roster by EOD 12/19 so we can print gate passes.
- Driver rest area: Cahill Events has secured a small crew room adjacent to the loading dock — keys will be available at the registration desk. Drivers must check in with on-site lead (Naomi).
- EV considerations: If you have EVs, charging is limited to two Level 2 stalls in Lot A; if more EV support is needed let us know and we'll arrange a mobile charger.

Attachments: parking_map_sfo_v3.pdf (PDF) — map with staging + Lot B location.

Next steps: 
1) Olson: return completed fleet_manifest_dec18.csv by 12/19 EOD.
2) Naomi: will submit permit and confirm passes.
3) Logan: can you approve up to two rental pickups as overflow?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll treat this as high priority.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Events & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, Olson Logistics <ops@olsonlogistics.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com, events@cahill.co
Date: 2026-12-18T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Night operations — arrival window and overnight staging

Marissa / Ben — quick operational notes from facilities: 
- Permit: Lot B overnight/vendor permit required; I've started the request (see attached permit_request_form.pdf). Facilities says approval usually takes 24–48 hrs; I'll escalate to secure same-day sign-off.
- Passes: we can issue 6 vendor passes + 2 overflow vendor permits (these will be kept at gate, hand to drivers).
- Loading dock: Access gate code will be provided the morning of 12/20 to the Olson driver lead only (security request).
- On-site liaison: I'll be on-site from 20:00–02:00 and will manage passes and the crew room access.

Logan — as noted, we will likely need 2 rental cars as overflow in case of late arrivals beyond manifest. Can you confirm approval so I can book? If approved, I'll reserve with priority pick-up at SFO to be available 22:30–23:30.

Ben — can you confirm whether any vehicles require EV charging and if so list VIN/plate so we can allocate the two Level 2 stalls?

Thanks — attaching permit_request_form.pdf for your records.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Site Logistics Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: permit_request_form.pdf (PDF)

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Olson Logistics <ops@olsonlogistics.com>, naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com
Cc: logan_wright@redwoodinference.com, events@cahill.co, alicia.park@acme.com
Date: 2026-12-19T07:22:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Night fleet + parking summary and next steps (Dec 20 workshop)

Thanks team — final confirmation & action items consolidated below. Reply only for exceptions.

Summary of confirmed items:
- Loading dock window: 22:00–02:00 on 12/20. Drivers must check in with Naomi and radio "Event Ops" channel 3 when 10 minutes out.
- Overnight vendor parking: 6 Lot B passes approved; 2 overflow vendor permits held at gate. Permit request submitted by Naomi.
- Driver rest area: Cahill crew room adjacent to loading dock (keys at registration).
- EV charging: two Level 2 stalls in Lot A reserved on a first-come basis; Olson to supply VIN/plates for allocation.
- Staging/drop-off: service lane on 2nd Street per parking_map_sfo_v3.pdf.

Attachments included for your processing: fleet_manifest_dec18.csv (please return completed), parking_map_sfo_v3.pdf, permit_request_form.pdf.

Action items: 
- Olson: return completed fleet_manifest_dec18.csv by 12/19 EOD (Ben).
- Naomi: finalize permit and confirm gate-code distribution morning of 12/20.
- Logan: confirm (approve) up to 2 rental overflow cars so Naomi can reserve — 12/19 noon.
- Alicia Park (Acme): confirm any VIP arrivals that require dedicated car service and send ETA window by 12/19 noon.

If there are no exceptions I'll distribute a single one-page driver instruction sheet to all drivers by 12/20 09:00.

Thanks everybody — heading into execution mode.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Events & Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: fleet_manifest_dec18.csv, parking_map_sfo_v3.pdf, permit_request_form.pdf
